name: Bayan Run 2026
short_description: Bayan Run 2026 is a multi-distance road race, headlined by a half marathon, held October 11, 2026 in Balikpapan, Indonesia.
ai_summary: Bayan Run 2026 is a road race scheduled for October 11, 2026, in Balikpapan, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia. The event offers multiple distance options, including a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and 0.8 km races. It will be based at Lapangan Merdeka 3 and BSCC Dome.

core_facts.venue: Lapangan Merdeka 3, Balikpapan | BSCC Dome, Balikpapan

pros: Water stations every 2 km, with medical teams along the route
Prize money of Rp400 million in 2025, with master categories paid three deep
Free post-race food, a recovery zone and physiotherapy at the finish
A big field of about 6,000, with bands and performers along the road
Kids' races over 800 m and 2.5 km on the Saturday
cons: Heavy air: 27°C and a 25°C dew point at the 5.30am start in 2025, and it never cooled
Long queues for the most popular free food after the 2025 race
The course shares the road with traffic, and the 2026 route was not yet published
Race packs only at the BSCC Dome on 9-10 October; entries non-refundable and non-transferable

research_highlights: The 2025 edition's Half Marathon route ran from Lapangan Merdeka out to the cargo entrance of SAMS Sepinggan Balikpapan Airport and back, described by the 21K men's winner as very steril (traffic-free/secure).
Race route passes several Balikpapan landmarks including Tugu Monpera, Plaza Balikpapan, and Tugu Beruang Madu.
In 2025, water stations were placed every 2 kilometers along the course with medical teams stationed throughout.
Participation roughly doubled in 2025 to about 6,000 runners compared to the prior year, and organizers plan an even larger field for 2026.
Post-race, organizers lay on a large free food area (nasi uduk, bakso, soto, rawon and more, in the tens of varieties) though popular items can have long queues.
research_watchouts: Long queues formed for the most popular free post-race food items (e.g. nasi uduk), leaving some finishers disappointed even though many other food options were available.
The 2025 race director acknowledged there were some minor operational hiccups ('kendala kecil') during the event, though they were resolved quickly.

faqs.question: When is Bayan Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: Bayan Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 11, 2026. This date applies to the full event, which includes the half marathon along with the other distance categories offered at the race, all held on the same day in Balikpapan, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Bayan Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Bayan Run 2026 offers five distance options: 21 km (the half marathon, listed as the primary distance at 21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and 0.8 km. This range allows participants of varying experience levels and fitness to choose a suitable distance.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is held in Balikpapan, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia, with venues listed as Lapangan Merdeka 3 and the BSCC Dome, both in Balikpapan. These locations serve as the event's key sites for the various distance categories on race day.
